title: DC-area forecast: Becoming mostly sunny this weekend, with heat returning to start week
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Dry and comfortable again today with low humidity and eventually more sun than clouds. Highs near 80 to the mid-80s make for a nice outdoor day.

What’s next? Enjoy the sunshine through Sunday before a shower or storm chance by evening. More typical July heat returns Monday with an afternoon storm chance, then increasing clouds Tuesday as severe storm chances rise.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Comfortable weather overall, but I'd take a little more sunshine. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): Another nice day once early clouds give way to partly to mostly sunny skies by late morning and afternoon. Highs rise to near 80 to the mid-80s, with modest humidity (dew points near 60) keeping that comfortable feeling going. With light winds, it‘s an ideal afternoon to enjoy the outdoors. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A quiet night ahead as mostly clear skies hang on. Light winds continue, with overnight lows falling into the mid- to upper 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Mainly sunny skies and trending warmer, as highs reach the mid- to upper 80s, with some spots potentially clipping 90. Light winds are expected throughout. Any chance for a shower or storm is mainly confined to the evening. Another day to enjoy the outdoors! Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy with a few showers and a rumble possible during the evening and overnight. Lows fall to the mid-60s to around 70. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Founder — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Typical July weather returns as the work week kicks off on Monday with mostly sunny skies, rising humidity, and highs reaching the upper 80s to low 90s. A building dip in the jet stream nearby brings the potential for an afternoon shower or thunderstorm. Perhaps a better chance of showers or storms Monday night with lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

Tuesday should bring increased rain chances at times. The afternoon into evening likely has the greatest potential for stronger storms as daytime heating helps add fuel. Isolated to scattered damaging winds, some hail, and potentially flooding will be the main factors to watch. Highs may trend a touch cooler with the extra clouds around, so mainly mid-80s to near 90. Confidence: Medium

Wednesday should start off with decreasing rain chances and increasing sunshine. Highs reach the mid- to upper 80s, with a chance for an afternoon shower. Confidence: Low-Medium

High pressure begins to build in by Thursday, allowing highs to climb back to near 90 with plenty of sunshine and lower humidity. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for July 25

A violent 2010 thunderstorm outbreak followed intense heat, bringing destructive winds, fatalities, and widespread power outages.
